title: Construct supercells and define diffusion tunnels
action: Using a rutile VO2 crystal structure, build supercells for stoichiometric VO2 and oxygen-deficient VO2-δ with one oxygen vacancy. Identify stable proton insertion sites and define the three diffusion tunnels (tunnel 1: H3→H2, tunnel 2: H7→H6, tunnel 3: H9→H12) along the [001] direction. Save the prepared initial atomic configurations.
description: Prepares the atomic models needed for subsequent DFT relaxation and barrier calculations. The evidence artifact documents the cell parameters and atomic positions of the constructed structures.

title: DFT+U structural relaxation
action: Relax the lattice parameters and atomic coordinates of all supercells using DFT+U (GGA-PBE, U=3.25 eV on V 3d states) with a suitable plane‑wave energy cutoff and k‑point sampling, converging Hellmann–Feynman forces below 0.01 eV/Å.
description: Produces the relaxed ground‑state structures required as input for the migration barrier calculations. The evidence file contains the final relaxed atomic coordinates.

title: Compute proton migration barriers
action: Using the relaxed structures, compute the proton migration energy barrier for stoichiometric VO2 and for oxygen-deficient VO2-δ along the three pre‑defined tunnels (tunnel 1: H3→H2, tunnel 2: H7→H6, tunnel 3: H9→H12). Employ NEB or CI‑NEB at the same DFT+U level to obtain the minimum‑energy path and extract each barrier height (energy difference between saddle point and initial minimum). Collect all barriers into a single CSV file.
description: CSV file containing the computed proton migration barriers. Each row corresponds to one system/pathway combination. The checker verifies the barrier values against the paper‑reported gold within tolerance and confirms that all oxygen‑deficient barriers are lower than the stoichiometric one.
output_schema: Columns: system (string: 'stoichiometric' or 'oxygen-deficient'), tunnel (string: empty string for stoichiometric, 'tunnel1','tunnel2','tunnel3' for oxygen-deficient), barrier_eV (float, unit eV). At least 4 rows.
